metadata.scenario: A new customer calls to cancel their cleaning service, citing dissatisfaction with past appointments. Category: Cancellation. Flags: cancellation_risk.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Patricia Wilson, and I'm calling about my mother’s upcoming hip replacement surgery. Hi, Patricia! Thanks for calling. I hope your mother’s surgery goes well. How can we assist you with her care? Well, I'm actually considering post-surgery care, but I also have some concerns. Of course, I’d be happy to help with that. What are your concerns? I’ve been hearing mixed reviews about care services. My mother had a bad experience with another agency. I'm sorry to hear that, Patricia. We pride ourselves on quality care. Can you share what happened? They frequently canceled last minute, and the caregivers didn’t seem well-trained. I just don’t want to go through that again. I completely understand your frustration. At CareFirst, we have a strict hiring process and ongoing training for our staff. That’s good to know. But I still feel apprehensive. That’s perfectly normal. If it helps, I can connect you with families we've worked with for their feedback. That might help. I’m also worried about costs. Our post-surgery recovery care ranges from $85 to $110 per visit, depending on the level of care needed. That sounds reasonable. How many hours would she need? Typically, we recommend 1 to 3 hours based on individual needs, especially during the initial recovery phase. I see. Could you send me a care plan outlining that? Absolutely! I can have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, reach out to you. That would be great. I’d appreciate it. Would you like me to schedule a follow-up call after Lisa contacts you? Yes, that’d be helpful. Perfect. Can I have your preferred contact number for Lisa to reach you? Sure, it’s +13165558471. Thank you, Patricia. I’ll make sure Lisa follows up with you and we’ll touch base afterwards. Sounds good. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome! We're here to support you and your mother. Have a great day! You too, bye! Bye!
